cv.name: Daan Evers
cv.headline: Chemical Engineering Student | Quality Assurance & Control
cv.summary: Final-year chemical technology student doing my graduation internship in quality engineering at a food ingredients plant. I have lab experience from a part-time QC job and like working on the plant floor with operators to find the real cause of a problem.

experience.title: QA/QC Intern (graduation internship – Quality Eng.)
bullets: Graduation project on reducing out-of-spec batches in the spray-drying line
Analysed two years of batch data in Minitab and proposed new control limits for moisture content
Joined internal HACCP and FSSC 22000 audits as an observer and wrote the audit notes
Led an 8D investigation on foreign material complaints together with production

experience.title: Student Assistant QC Lab (bijbaan)
bullets: Viscosity, gloss and colour testing of incoming raw materials and finished batches
Entered results in the LIMS and flagged deviations to the lab supervisor

education.school: Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences (Hogeschool Rotterdam)
